verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents a public Cloud API (client.runs.create, sessions, events polling, structured output) and an open-source Python library, showing a documented programmatic interface usable by AI-native developers. However, no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (404s across candidate paths), so full machine-readable API discoverability is unconfirmed, and evidence is entirely vendor docs without independent hands-on API corroboration. missing for 10: public OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer corroboration of the API beyond vendor docs.
